caption: The drawing shows a single elongated, tapered wooden object, possibly a carved stick or staff, oriented diagonally on a plain, light beige background. The object is decorated with various symbols and motifs in red, green, and black. At the top, there is a five-pointed star enclosed in a circle, with a red S-shape inside it, and leafy or floral designs carved above it. Below the star, the letters "D A" are inscribed on either side of interlocking outlined red hearts, encircled by small red triangular shapes. Beneath this, the letters "H.W.B." are written. The central section features a long wavy main vine or branch with multiple curling offshoots, bordered by red, green, and black small leaves and simple hearts. Lower on the object, there is a drawing of a quadruped animal resembling a dog or fox, and near the pointed end, a small geometric shape is inscribed in green. Throughout the surface, subtle shading and line work enhance the details of the carved and painted decorations.
title: Scrimshaw: Swordfish Bill
